title: Release directory permissions
lesson: Set a committed export root to 0755 before rsync and verify service-user traversal. mkdtemp creates 0700 directories, and rsync -a can copy that mode into production and cause systemd 200/CHDIR.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Observed during the broker-history release workflow; the prepared committed exports subsequently used 0755.

title: Resolve the project test runner
lesson: If npx resolves a broken or cross-project Vitest launcher, verify its target and invoke node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run with the focused test files. Do not alter product code to repair a foreign launcher.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: The local npx launcher resolved into another checkout and failed to import @vitest/utils/helpers; direct local invocation passed.

title: Use disposable database test configuration
lesson: Database integration tests require UTARUS_TEST_DATABASE_URL explicitly naming utarus_test_admin. Use the disposable-database helper; never substitute an application or production database, and report an unavailable integration check accurately.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: The wider verification could not run database persistence tests without the dedicated admin URL.

title: Separate existing failures from regressions
lesson: Reproduce unexpected failures from an unchanged committed export before attributing them to a patch. Report passing focused checks, reproduced pre-existing failures, and unavailable checks separately.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Two wider-suite failures reproduced from the unchanged baseline during the broker fee work.

title: Verify structured success after fatal diagnostics
lesson: A process can log [FATAL] Uncaught Exception and still return exit code zero. Require a completed validation receipt and explicit state/source checks; operator scripts should catch failures and set a nonzero exit status.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Several operator validation exceptions were logged as fatal while the shell reported exit zero; success was established only by the completed reconciliation receipt.

title: Preserve known facts while validating enrichment
lesson: Compare previously known financial values exactly, allowing only representation-equivalent decimal formatting. Audit previously null cash and unknown intent becoming known separately, and prove those additions from broker records or reconciled quantity evidence.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: The initial invariance check incorrectly rejected null-to-reported-cash and unknown-to-verified-intent enrichment; the final source checks in bcce3e0 verified both additions and preservation of known facts.

title: Wait for complete asynchronous exports
lesson: Wait for the producer to finish successfully before parsing its output file. A yielded session and a growing file are unfinished work. Validate completion and parseability before dependent steps; investigate malformed input rather than assuming every parse error is a partial write.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: A validation reader attempted to parse an export while its SSH producer was still running and received an unterminated-string JSON error.
match: JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string|Unexpected end of JSON input

title: Return concise remote validation results
lesson: Prefer source comparisons on the server and return counts, hashes and receipts. If transferring a baseline is necessary, compress it. Avoid downloading a complete portfolio merely to establish a few invariants.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: A redundant full-state export was much slower than the compressed-baseline remote validation that verified the same invariants.

title: Benchmark and verify backup transfers
lesson: Measure transfer progress early. For a slow immutable archive, verified byte-range transfers can reuse the existing prefix and run concurrently. Verify the assembled length, SHA256 and decryptability before pruning the previous complete backup.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: The sequential encrypted-backup transfer was slow; parallel ranges completed the verified copy while the prior complete backup stayed available.

title: Check authentication before a historical backfill
lesson: Perform the smallest authorized account check before promising a historical recovery. HTTP 401 establishes a retrieval failure, not missing transactions or an expired-key diagnosis. Preserve retained data, continue independent authorized work and honor a user decision to leave the connection pending.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: An additional account rejected discovery and cash-log requests with HTTP 401; that account was left pending at the user request.

title: Use exact fee evidence and conservation
lesson: Recover leg fees from account-bound broker cash records, verify contract, side, currency and trade cash, and require exact parent-fee conservation. Preserve reported zeroes and rebates; leave ambiguous fees unknown. Obtain approval for undocumented source associations rather than inventing a leg split.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Cash-log recovery and the explicitly approved Tiger Trade-block association were validated in af3fba0 and bcce3e0.

title: Verify provider and transport parity
lesson: Verify each broker endpoint and adapter path. Moomoo and Futubull Cloud share the Cloud adapter; Futubull OpenD is a separate SDK transport. Test both Cloud hosts and state which native gateway paths lack live validation.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Shared Cloud behavior was verified against the live Futubull endpoint; OpenD had no configured live gateway during bcce3e0 validation.

title: Plan complete historical fee retrieval
lesson: Verify pagination, time units, parent-order coverage and the documented endpoint quota before a full backfill. Incremental sync must revisit retained unknown fees outside its normal window. Keep incomplete source evidence and coverage gaps visible instead of treating omissions as zero or adding a cutoff.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: Historical fee recovery required complete paginated cash evidence and revisiting older parent orders in both broker fixes.

title: Report the scope of closure precisely
lesson: Separate fee completeness, broker-reported cash availability, contract metadata and open/close intent. Name user-deferred authentication failures and unavailable live validation explicitly; closing a fee gap does not establish complete historical coverage.
evidence: 2026-10-28 broker-recovery round: The final broker checks closed the verified fee gaps while retaining separate metadata/intent gaps and a user-deferred connection.

title: Inspect backing shares before diagnosing option loss
lesson: When an expiry-loss card treats a short call as uncovered, inspect the same-account underlying shares as well as long options. Verify the diagnosis against the affected retained view before claiming that a generic spread or symbol fix resolves it. Include backing-share cost only if the approved metric definition includes stock loss; explain and obtain approval before broadening an options metric. Never count the same shares twice across expiry groups.
evidence: Session review of 5c2581a and 4eeb953: a generic symbol correction did not diagnose the affected covered call, and adding backing-share cost broadened the metric before its definition was settled.

title: Keep a verified backup when off-server transfers stall
lesson: Track deployment health independently of backup transfer success. If range transfers time out or stall, preserve the previous verified off-server backup, keep and verify the new server backup, record the transfer as incomplete, and do not report the new set as verified off server. Stop stalled read-only transfer processes before cleaning their partial files.
evidence: Velovest 4eeb953: deployed source and public assets verified; new server backup passed checksums and decryption; timed-out and stalled range transfers were stopped and the previous verified off-server set retained.

title: Build broker fixtures from the current account schema
lesson: Cross-page financial tests must include the complete account-source model, source IDs and connector-specific account config, plus execution contract IDs. Reuse existing typed fixture builders where possible; validate fixture construction before running the browser portion to avoid repeated setup-only failures.
evidence: Table-consistency regression fixture required broker_sources, contract_id and Tiger config.account before the financial and browser assertions could run.

title: Reconcile table figures by financial basis
lesson: Compare matching account, contract, quantity and currency before comparing financial amounts. Separate broker position cost, execution opening cash, latest roll cash and current valuation; do not substitute book cost for execution cash. Cross-page checks should use the same mark and probability inputs and preserve fractional strikes. When shared model rules change, invalidate saved calculations without discarding daily history.
evidence: Table consistency round: five retained portfolio projections audited; approved shared option valuation/cash-flow helper, broker-mark risk alignment and fractional-strike rendering passed focused data and desktop/mobile checks.

title: Prepare derived views before a calculation release
lesson: When a release changes projection fingerprints or financial calculation rules, prepare new derived views from verified retained inputs while the old service runs. After all replacements start, recheck the source fingerprint before atomically installing each prepared view; keep a newer valid generation rather than overwriting it. Preserve quote timestamps and daily history, and verify both account and broker scopes.
evidence: Velovest 3d16346: five views prepared against the prior fingerprint; four installed after restart and one already rebuilt by the worker; 274 P&L, 274 risk and 18 premium checks passed.

title: Confirm financial metric scope before changing its formula
lesson: Before changing a financial metric, state which instruments, capital, account, fees, currency and valuation basis it includes. Test the user's exact example and verify the affected portfolio. A request to fix a number does not authorize adding backing-share cost or replacing maximum loss with margin, stress loss or another metric; obtain explicit approval for a definition change.
evidence: Session review of 4eeb953: the covered-call correction included stock cost in an options figure before its intended scope had been confirmed.

title: Make claims match the evidence and approved scope
lesson: A passing generic example establishes that example, not the cause of a live screenshot. Verify the actual affected view before reporting it fixed. Batch necessary clarification into concrete numerical or UI choices, reuse existing approvals, and keep calculation fixes within the approved layout and controls.
evidence: Session review: the affected-view inspection identified the covered-call cause; the later approved table audit reproduced differences and verified the deployed account and broker views in 3d16346.
